title: Grid column editors in the field repository
summary: The field repository keeps the in-place editor of each cxGrid column: its PropertiesClassName and its Properties.* lines as the form has them
intro: Read this when the editor of a grid column (combo box, image combo, currency edit, ...) should be kept with the column in the field repository. drag-lint repo read-dfm stores PropertiesClassName and the Properties.* lines of every column of a table or banded view in DL_GRID_COLUMNS (schema 5), as the text of the form, and shows a changed editor as one update per value. A schema-4 repository is read as before and the run says the editors were left out.

questions.ask: Which editor does each grid column of a form have, and how do I keep it in the field repository?
Did the editor of a grid column change since the form was last read?
Why does read-dfm say the editor properties of grid columns are not read?
